column1: # MUST_CONTAIN.tsv -- the BOM for v1.0.121.
# CARRIED VERBATIM from cuts/v1.0.120/MUST_CONTAIN.tsv (OS003 main 7c985c05) by ORM 2026-10-30, so the
# hub-v0.5.31 rows have a BOM to land in. v1.0.120 was tagged (d17c4223) and its walk FAILED; v1.0.121
# is the next cut. Every carried row is the v1.0.120 row as written, landed state included; the cut
# freeze re-measures landed against cut/v1.0.121. Rows appended below the carried file are new for 121
# and were added with bin/bom_add.sh. Other v1.0.121 rows (CM051 installer fixes) are added by their
# owners as they land.
# ---- v1.0.120 file follows ----
# MUST_CONTAIN.tsv -- the BOM for v1.0.120.
# CARRIED VERBATIM from cuts/v1.0.119/MUST_CONTAIN.tsv (OS003 main 69a5630b) by ORM 2026-10-29 on the
# release lead's ruling: v1.0.120 is v1.0.119 relabelled after a cut-machinery failure (the v1.0.119 tag
# was refused at cut.yml preflight step 22 on a wiki-image provenance marker); no new scope. The only
# CM051 change in v1.0.120 is that marker re-key plus the version bump, neither of which is shipped
# behaviour, so no row is added. Every row below is the v1.0.119 row as written, landed state included
# (ancestry of cut/v1.0.120, which is the v1.0.119 tag plus those two commits).
# ---- v1.0.119 file follows ----
# MUST_CONTAIN.tsv -- the BOM for v1.0.119.
# Opened 2026-10-24 by Aesop's builder on Archie's instruction, from OS003 main (eefeb5d).
# No v1.0.119 artefact exists yet, so landed=no on every row is correct.
# WHAT THIS FILE DOES NOT YET CARRY (the cut-freeze step's job, not done here)
# It does NOT carry the v1.0.116 rows (OS003 main) or the v1.0.117 rows. The
# v1.0.117 BOM never reached OS003 main: it exists only on OPEN PR #411
# (head 1ca2b8f, 13 rows, and the 15 manifest rows those rows name are on the
# same unmerged branch). The v1.0.117 cut vendored it from that branch
# (CM051 cuts/BOM_PIN on tag v1.0.117 cites 1ca2b8f). Carry-forward needs
# re-citation to the v1.0.119 pins, so it is left to ORM at freeze.
# CAPABILITY GUARDS
# When opened, capability_id=none on every row: no manifest row on main named
# any of these PRs. 2026-10-24: the P13, ingest-contract, W11 and Smart Prefs
# rows now name probes added by OS003 #414 (each pattern taken from the PR's
# own code; 0 in the v1.0.117 tag tree and DMG). THOSE IDS DANGLE UNTIL #414
# MERGES, so #414 merges first. The two Smart Prefs ids are required=warn
# (PENDING: not yet vendored into CM051). Every other row stays none: no probe
# is invented here.
# REFS
# CM051 refs are squash merges on CM051 main. Four CM051 merges (#3133,
# #3114, #3112, #3100) were already in v1.0.117 as cut-branch picks; their
# rows cite the main merge and name the pick.
# Upstream refs (CM044, CM048, ostler-assistant, personal-world-graph) are
# merges on that repo's main. Each row says how it reaches the DMG and
# whether that has happened: a CM044 fix needs the wiki image rebuild plus a
# CM051 re-pin; an oa fix needs a hub re-pin; the PWG Smart Prefs rows reach
# the DMG only through the CM051 #3116 stack (OPEN at writing).
# NOT LISTED, not merged at writing: CM051 #3149, #3151, #3116; CM044 #400;
# PWG #439 (T0i). Each is added by bin/bom_add.sh as it lands.
# OFF-DMG, recorded here and deliberately NOT rows
# A row must reach landed=yes in the DMG or gates/verify_must_contain.sh reds
# the cut, and these never enter the DMG. There is no off-DMG convention in
# bin/bom_add.sh or the gate, so they are recorded as comments.
#   iOS (CM031, ships via TestFlight):
#     #339 c3833441  P13 hide short codes up to 8 digits, show phone-only people
#     #343 21b1009a  re-pairing an already-paired iPhone no longer fails and wipes data
#     #345 fae4f7f8  I14 relaunch unlock (paired app reopens its database, no paywall)
#     #347 533b06ba  old-Hub database removed 30 days after the move; Siri phrases
#       #339, #343, #345 and #347 are all ancestors of 533b06ba, the head of
#       TestFlight 2026102404 (the v1.0.117 F&F send), so all four were already
#       in that build.

#     #351 447661ab  I19 warm each tab's data after launch, unlock and pairing
